observedBehavior: A changed text file returns Git zero-context hunk coordinates without source lines.
A mapped target whose indexed line falls inside a new hunk is labeled as an overlap hint.
Other targets in the same file remain potential impacts; neither label claims a semantic contract change.
limitations: The source index commonly stores a line anchor, not an AST-backed symbol range; an anchor outside a hunk cannot exclude impact.
Untracked, binary, renamed, deleted, type-changing and mode-only paths may lack line locations and remain file-level associations.
Line coordinates do not establish current index freshness, changed contract shape, owner coverage or verification relevance.
Team parity, browser/keyboard acceptance and the full D1 gate remain open.
